in_hebrew.name: מורתי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Mortie is derived from the Hebrew word 'mavet' which means death, and the suffix 'it' which means my. Thus, Mortie can be translated as 'my death' or 'my bitterness'. In a biblical context, this name may be given to someone who is experiencing great sorrow or hardship.

in_greek.name: Μορτιάς
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Mortie is derived from the word 'mortos' which means dead or death. This name may be given to someone who has experienced loss or tragedy in their life, or as a reminder of the inevitability of death.

in_latin.name: Mortarius
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Mortie is derived from the word 'mortuus' which means dead. This name may be given to someone who has experienced loss or tragedy, or as a reminder of the reality of death.
